deviation: The confidentiality survival period is cut from 3 years to 1 year after the NDA ends, which is below both the 3-year playbook position and the 2-year fallback. Arcadia's confidential information would lose protection too early, and there is no carve-out for trade secrets.
suggested_text: Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information confidential, use it only for the purposes of this NDA, and continue to do so for 3 years after the NDA ends.
